def test_my_mood_card(self):
        try:
            # 初始化发现页操作类（传入self即可复用所有minium对象）
            home_page = HomePage(self)

            # 进入广场页
            home_page.goto_home_page()

            # 展开侧边栏
            home_page.goto_my_page()

            # 等待加载侧边栏
            self.page.wait_for(
                lambda: self.page.element_is_exists(home_user_mood_old_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout),
                max_timeout=max_timeout)

            # 点击心情名片 image
            user_mood_btn = self.page.get_element(home_user_mood_old_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            if user_mood_btn:
                self.logger.info(f"点击 初始 心情名片icon")
                user_mood_btn.tap()
            else:
                user_mood_btn_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_mood_new_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
                user_mood_btn = user_mood_btn_list[1]
                self.logger.info(f"点击 新春 心情名片icon")
                user_mood_btn.click()

            time.sleep(2)

            # 等待加载 心情名片
            self.page.wait_for(
                lambda: self.page.element_is_exists(home_user_mood_swiper_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout),
                max_timeout=max_timeout)

            mood_swiper_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_mood_swiper_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            assert len(mood_swiper_list) == 3,f"心情名片数量 !=3，请手动检查"

            self.logger.info(f"获取心情名片成功")
            self.capture(f"获取心情名片成功_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}")

        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"获取心情名片失败：{str(e)}")
            # 异常时截图
            self.capture(f"获取心情名片失败_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}")
            raise

        time.sleep(2)
